name: Shelter Home for Children
legalName: Persaudaraan Perlindungan Kristian Untuk Bantuan Dan Kebajikan Shelter
summary: A registered Christian welfare organisation that rescues, protects and restores children and youth affected by abuse, neglect or abandonment, and reunites them with their families where possible.
programmes: Shelter Homes: temporary residential care for children and teens
Shelter After School (SAS) for latchkey children and youth
Sponsor-a-Child and Gift of Love giving
beneficiaries: Children, teens and youth from abusive, neglectful or otherwise adverse backgrounds

organisation.founders: A group of seven friends, including James Nayagam (later Executive Director); began with tuition classes for children in a squatter settlement on Old Klang Road
